decisions.reason: As a core office-system extension with several models and clear website support, it is likely near aspiration and the firm's hiring and R&D slack favor giving it more time.
A chair family fits the firm's established premium furnishing range closely, so boundedly rational management would usually retain it unless results were clearly below aspiration.
The floor cushions are more niche and somewhat peripheral, but they still build on the firm's materials and interior-solution logic, making continued trial more likely than withdrawal.

The sofa is strategically close to the firm's offer but had weaker website prominence, so it is the most vulnerable line, yet available organizational slack still makes near-term retention slightly more likely.

A high standing table is a close adjacency for contemporary workplace and conference settings, and an established launch presence suggests performance has not triggered strong problemistic search away from it.

Although more distant from the legacy offer, the rug collection was presented as a flagship direction, so management would likely tolerate early uncertainty and keep investing unless outcomes were clearly disappointing.
